#### Independence 2: Random network interference

We make the assumption that interference respects a mapping between individuals and neighborhoods as given by random [graph](#def-graph) $\mathbf \Psi$, and the empty graph $\mathbf 0$.


$$
\begin{aligned}
&  f_{\mathbf R_s}    & &\text{is loyal to} &  \mathbf{\Psi}_{s-1}\\
&  f_{\mathbf T_s}      & &\text{is loyal to} &  \mathbf{0}\\
&  f_{\mathbf M_s}      & &\text{is loyal to} &  \mathbf{\Psi}_{s}\\
&  f_{\mathbf V_s}      & &\text{is loyal to} &  \mathbf{0}\\
\end{aligned}
$$
